==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=motion picture|:bor|la:videō<id:see>|:influence|audio|tree=1}}
From the root ''vide'' of {{bor|en|la|videō||to see}} + ''-o'', formed in analogy to {{m|en|audio}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈvɪd.i.əʊ/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈvɪd.i.oʊ/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-video.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|[ˈʋi.ɖɪ.jo]|[ˈʋiɖ.jo]|[ʋiːɖ(ɪ)joˑ]|a=Indic}}
* {{IPA|en|[ˈvɪ.di.əʉ]|[ˈvɪ.di.ɐʉ]|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|[ˈvə.di.ɐʉ]|a=NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|[ˈbi.dʒo]|a=Philippines}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~|s|videmus<l:rare,humorous>|es<l:nonstandard>}}
[[File:VHS cassette tape 05.JPG|thumb|right|A [[VHS]] '''video''' casette]]

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} [[transient|Transient]] [[visual]] [[content]] or [[media]], [[processed]] with [[technology]], especially [[electronic]].
#: {{ux|en|Early TV used film to record '''video'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Which cable is for the '''video''' feed?}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[recording]] or [[medium]] of [[visual]] [[content]], especially [[audiovisual]] content for [[playback]]; a [[motion picture]], [[movie]], [[film]].
#: {{syn|en|clip|vid}}
#: We edited a '''video''' montage of Robbie's first birthday.
#: We used to make '''videos''' on tape recorders.
#: Check out the '''videos''' I uploaded online.
# {{lb|en|dated}} [[television|Television]] [[content]] or [[media]].
# {{lb|en|dated}} [[videotape]], [[VHS]].

====Usage notes====
* ''Video'' is used in contrast with {{m|en|audio}}, which is sound only. It is also sometimes used in contrast with {{m|en|film}} to describe all other motion picture formats, such as [[videotape]] and [[digital video]]. The words ''video'' and {{m|en|movie}} have some synonymous overlap, but a feature film on the big screen is only a ''movie'' in {{l|en|idiom|idiomatic}} use (not a ''video''), and web-era user-created videos are usually not called ''movies'' except in certain contexts.
* The plural {{m|en|videmus}} is rare and used for humorous effect. It is the first-person plural form of the Latin verb ("we see") in the same way that {{m|la|videō}} is the singular.
